CheckTitle: SFS Turbo file systems have encryption enabled
Description: Ensure that SFS Turbo file systems have encryption enabled using KMS keys.
Risk: Unencrypted SFS Turbo file systems expose data at rest to unauthorized access, potentially leading to data breaches.

Code.Other: The encryption attribute of an existing SFS Turbo file system cannot be changed. Create a new encrypted SFS Turbo file system with a KMS key, migrate the data and clients to it, verify the migration, and then delete the unencrypted file system.

Recommendation.Text: Create SFS Turbo file systems with KMS encryption enabled. Replace existing unencrypted file systems because their encryption attribute is immutable.

Notes: Checks if SFS Turbo file systems have a KMS key ID (crypt_key_id) set.
